WASD move · Space jump · Shift sprint · C dodge roll · Mouse look and aim (click the game to lock the mouse)

1 or F pickaxe · 2-6 your slots · Wheel next slot · E open chests, pick up, swap

Warm up on the spawn island, then everyone boards the plane. Space to jump out, hold W to dive, Space again to open your glider.

Loot comes in grey, green, blue, purple and gold. Chests glow and hum. Each gun takes one of four ammo kinds.
Bandages +15 up to 75 · Medkit full health · Small Shield +25 up to 50 · Shield Potion +50. Select one and hold fire.

No building: your pickaxe breaks walls. Hit the blue weak point for double damage.
The storm closes in every half minute or so. Outside the eye you lose health every second. Be the last one standing.
Click to place a marker · M to close
